description: Defines the pucch_power_controller class responsible for managing PUCCH power control, SINR updates, and TPC commands within a 5G NR scheduler implementation.

classes.name: pucch_power_controller
classes.description: Manages PUCCH power control, SINR updates, and TPC command computation for a UE in the scheduler.

methods.name: pucch_power_controller
methods.description: Constructor initializing the controller with UE configuration and logger.

methods.name: reconfigure
methods.description: Reconfigures the PUCCH power control parameters based on UE configuration.

methods.name: update_pucch_sinr_f0_f1
methods.description: Updates SINR for PUCCH formats 0 and 1.

methods.name: update_pucch_sinr_f2_f3_f4
methods.description: Updates SINR for PUCCH formats 2, 3, and 4.

methods.name: update_pucch_pw_ctrl_state
methods.description: Stores power control state at the transmission slot.

methods.name: compute_tpc_command
methods.description: Computes TPC command to reach target SINR for formats 0/2/3.

methods.name: get_tpc
methods.description: Calculates TPC value based on SINR difference.
